_doc: The expressway with no footway (specification 003 T008, Ptraffic-85): an expressway laid across the town's middle at grade, over its streets, the clock run 10 s so walkers and cars are out. Its edge (a shoulder where a footway stood) at street level from four azimuths, near (40 px a metre); oblique (35 degrees, along it: at 300 degrees a tower took the view) and from above (75) mid (12); the crossings with the streets far (5) from above: crosswalks over the streets, none over the expressway; by day, then near and mid by night (22 h).
